## 2. FOSS / Open-Weight LMs & Tools
**MiniMax M3 released**

- **Date:** 2026-06-01
- **Primary source:** [MiniMax — MiniMax M3: Frontier Coding, 1M Context, Native Multimodality](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-m3)
- **Summary:** MiniMax announced M3, an open-weight model aimed at coding, agentic workflows, long-context tasks, native image/video input, and computer use. It is available through MiniMax Code, Token Plan, and API; MiniMax says technical report and weights are planned within 10 days.
- **Why it matters:** Adds another serious open-weight entrant in the coding-agent segment, with 1M-token context and multimodal/computer-use positioning directly relevant to developer automation.

## 9. Podcast Highlights
**Office AI tools that actually work**

- **Date:** 2026-06-01
- **Primary source:** [The AI Daily Brief — Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/gb/podcast/the-ai-daily-brief-formerly-the-ai-breakdown/id1680633614)
- **Summary:** Episode focus was practical office AI usage across slides, spreadsheets, email, research, and meeting notes. The useful operating principle: prioritize AI tools embedded in repeatable office workflows with clear task ownership and measurable output, rather than generic chatbot adoption.
- **Available now:** Yes, as a workflow-selection tactic rather than a single product launch.
- **How to use it:** Pick one recurring office workflow, define the owner and success metric, then test embedded AI tools already inside the system of record before adding standalone tools.
- **Why it matters:** Enterprise AI value is concentrating around specific workflow integration, not broad undirected access.
